loadWarnings.message: #@ persist source "daily_orders" is not built, so it is answered live: it declares refresh="incremental", which is not supported on dialect "duckdb". Incremental refresh reads a bounded watermark range out of the source and applies it transactionally, so it is enabled only where the publisher has proven both: postgres, snowflake, standardsql (BigQuery). Use refresh="full" to build it; the supported set widens in a later release.
loadWarnings.subject: daily_orders
